description: Figure 6(a), titled “Video type distribution,” is a pie chart illustrating the proportional breakdown of 14 distinct video categories within the benchmark dataset. The chart is segmented into colored wedges, each labeled with its corresponding category and percentage. The largest segment, representing “People Blogs,” occupies 17.2% of the chart and is colored orange. The second largest is “Entertainment” at 13.9% (purple), followed by “Howto Style” at 9.7% (green) and “Education” at 8.7% (red). Other categories include “Film Animation” (4.6%, brown), “Sports” (7.7%, pink), “Gaming” (6.4%, gray), “Travel Events” (4.6%, yellow-green), “Comedy” (5.6%, cyan), “Science Technology” (6.4%, blue), “News Politics” (4.3%, dark blue), “Pets Animals” (3.9%, dark green), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%, maroon), and “Music” (2.3%, light purple). Each slice is clearly labeled with its category name and percentage value, and the chart visually conveys the relative frequency of each video type in the dataset.
